    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "df=df.iloc[:,1:3]\n",
        "X=df.iloc[:,0].values\n",
        "y=df.iloc[:,1].values"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "xP3AuBaHrv7e"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "X=X.reshape(-1,1)\n",
        "y=y.reshape(-1,1)\n",
        "\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "ayaSWGxUs1kZ"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "m,features = X.shape\n",
        "print(m)\n",
        "print(features)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "RAUnnUHOtnSb",
        "outputId": "5f901522-9fcd-41fa-e206-19b6636c653c"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "50\n",
            "1\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Standardization\n",
        "x_mean = np.mean(X,axis=0)\n",
        "x_std = np.std(X,axis=0)\n",
        "X = (X-x_mean)/x_std"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "WuHPGmYzuGJe"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# MINIBATCH"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "hspLLVaxsAVn"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "#initialization\n",
        "w=np.random.randn(features,1)\n",
        "b=np.zeros((1,1))"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "E5CvVH1VsYMn"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "np.random.permutation(10)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "HcQcfBCNtpZc",
        "outputId": "4187cb54-d075-438a-c40d-07968d6da2bf"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "execute_result",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "array([3, 6, 1, 8, 0, 2, 5, 4, 7, 9])"
            ]
          },
          "metadata": {},
          "execution_count": 18
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Minibatch GD\n",
        "batch_size=32\n",
        "learning_rate=0.001\n",
        "epoch=1\n",
        "tol=0.005\n",
        "\n",
        "losses=[]\n",
        "prev_loss=float('inf')\n",
        "\n",
        "while epoch < 1000:\n",
        "  indices = np.random.permutation(m)\n",
        "  x_shuffled = X[indices]\n",
        "  y_shuffled = y[indices]\n",
        "\n",
        "  for i in range(0,m,batch_size):\n",
        "      X_batch=x_shuffled[i:i+batch_size]\n",
        "      y_batch=y_shuffled[i:i+batch_size]\n",
        "\n",
        "      #fp\n",
        "      y_hat=np.dot(X_batch,w)+b\n",
        "      error = y_hat-y_batch\n",
        "\n",
        "      #gradients\n",
        "      dw= ((1/len(X_batch)))*(np.dot(X_batch.T,error))\n",
        "      db = ((1/len(X_batch)))*(np.sum(error))\n",
        "\n",
        "      #update\n",
        "      w=w-learning_rate*dw\n",
        "      b=b-learning_rate*db\n",
        "\n",
        "      #loss\n",
        "\n",
        "  y_hat_full = np.dot(X,w)+b\n",
        "\n",
        "  current_loss=np.mean((y_hat_full-y)**2)\n",
        "\n",
        "  losses.append(current_loss)\n",
        "\n",
        "  if abs(prev_loss - current_loss) < tol:\n",
        "        break\n",
        "\n",
        "  prev_loss = current_loss\n",
        "  epoch += 1\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "final_loss =  losses[-1]\n",
        "print(final_loss)\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "x51adJdxuXEe",
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "outputId": "f6329ad5-82ec-4419-f20d-94a4a17030ca"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "91.22985737234329\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },

        "plt.plot(range(len(losses)), losses)\n",
        "plt.xlabel('Epoch')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Loss')\n",
        "plt.title('Loss over Epochs (Mini-Batch Gradient Descent)')\n",
        "plt.grid(True)\n",

      ],

      },
      "source": [
        "# Plotting the regression line\n",
        "plt.scatter(X, y, label='Original data')\n",
        "plt.plot(X, y_hat_full, color='red', label='Regression line')\n",
        "plt.xlabel('X (Standardized)')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Y')\n",
        "plt.title('Mini-Batch Gradient Descent Regression')\n",
        "plt.legend()\n",
        "plt.grid(True)\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "dd843fb4"
      },
      "source": [
        "### Stochastic Gradient Descent"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "c67c62d4",
        "outputId": "578fde7a-5874-47a5-81fe-672713df8b64"
      },
      "source": [
        "# Initialization for SGD\n",
        "w_sgd = np.random.randn(features, 1)\n",
        "b_sgd = np.zeros((1, 1))\n",
        "\n",
        "learning_rate_sgd = 0.001 # Can be adjusted, often smaller than mini-batch\n",
        "epoch_sgd = 1\n",
        "tol_sgd = 0.005\n",
        "\n",
        "losses_sgd = []\n",
        "prev_loss_sgd = float('inf')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Stochastic Gradient Descent\n",
        "while epoch_sgd < 1000:\n",
        "    indices = np.random.permutation(m)\n",
        "    x_shuffled = X[indices]\n",
        "    y_shuffled = y[indices]\n",
        "\n",
        "    # In SGD, batch_size is 1\n",
        "    for i in range(0, m, 1):\n",
        "        X_batch = x_shuffled[i:i+1]\n",
        "        y_batch = y_shuffled[i:i+1]\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Forward pass\n",
        "        y_hat_batch = np.dot(X_batch, w_sgd) + b_sgd\n",
        "        error_batch = y_hat_batch - y_batch\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Gradients\n",
        "        dw_sgd = np.dot(X_batch.T, error_batch)\n",
        "        db_sgd = np.sum(error_batch)\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Update parameters\n",
        "        w_sgd = w_sgd - learning_rate_sgd * dw_sgd\n",
        "        b_sgd = b_sgd - learning_rate_sgd * db_sgd\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Calculate loss after each epoch using the full dataset\n",
        "    y_hat_full_sgd = np.dot(X, w_sgd) + b_sgd\n",
        "    current_loss_sgd = np.mean((y_hat_full_sgd - y)**2)\n",
        "    losses_sgd.append(current_loss_sgd)\n",
        "\n",
        "    if abs(prev_loss_sgd - current_loss_sgd) < tol_sgd:\n",
        "        break\n",
        "\n",
        "    prev_loss_sgd = current_loss_sgd\n",
        "    epoch_sgd += 1\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"SGD finished after {epoch_sgd} epochs. Final loss: {current_loss_sgd:.4f}\")"
      ],
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "SGD finished after 131 epochs. Final loss: 82.3632\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },

        "plt.xlabel('X (Standardized)')\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "3e74ff2f"
      },
      "source": [
        "## Two Predictors and One Response"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "78491cf1"
      },
      "source": [
        "First, let's generate a synthetic dataset with two features (X1, X2) and one target (Y)."
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "3d6aff35",
        "outputId": "0366b90e-8d18-45d1-cd35-05f38748ca53"
      },
      "source": [
        "# Generate synthetic data with 2 features\n",
        "np.random.seed(42)\n",
        "m_new = 100 # Number of samples\n",
        "X1_new = 5 * np.random.rand(m_new, 1)\n",
        "X2_new = 3 * np.random.rand(m_new, 1)\n",
        "y_new = 4 + 2 * X1_new + 3 * X2_new + np.random.randn(m_new, 1) # Linear relationship with noise\n",
        "\n",
        "X_new = np.hstack((X1_new, X2_new)) # Combine into a single feature matrix\n",
        "\n",
        "# Standardize the new features\n",
        "x_mean_new = np.mean(X_new, axis=0)\n",
        "x_std_new = np.std(X_new, axis=0)\n",
        "X_new_scaled = (X_new - x_mean_new) / x_std_new\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"New X_new_scaled shape: {X_new_scaled.shape}\")\n",
        "print(f\"New y_new shape: {y_new.shape}\")"
      ],
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "New X_new_scaled shape: (100, 2)\n",
            "New y_new shape: (100, 1)\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "6c0a240f"
      },
      "source": [
        "Now, let's adapt the Mini-Batch Gradient Descent algorithm for this two-feature dataset."
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "15fdfeef",
        "outputId": "46677ba6-7927-42a4-c72b-f13085010420"
      },
      "source": [
        "# Initialization for 2 features\n",
        "features_new = X_new_scaled.shape[1]\n",
        "w_new = np.random.randn(features_new, 1) # Weights for 2 features\n",
        "b_new = np.zeros((1, 1))\n",
        "\n",
        "batch_size_new = 20 # Using a new batch size for this example\n",
        "learning_rate_new = 0.01 # Adjusted learning rate\n",
        "epoch_new = 1\n",
        "tol_new = 0.001\n",
        "\n",
        "losses_new = []\n",
        "prev_loss_new = float('inf')\n",
        "\n",
        "m_new_samples = X_new_scaled.shape[0]\n",
        "\n",
        "while epoch_new < 5000: # Increased epochs for potentially slower convergence\n",
        "  indices_new = np.random.permutation(m_new_samples)\n",
        "  x_shuffled_new = X_new_scaled[indices_new]\n",
        "  y_shuffled_new = y_new[indices_new]\n",
        "\n",
        "  for i in range(0, m_new_samples, batch_size_new):\n",
        "      X_batch_new = x_shuffled_new[i:i+batch_size_new]\n",
        "      y_batch_new = y_shuffled_new[i:i+batch_size_new]\n",
        "\n",
        "      # Forward pass\n",
        "      y_hat_batch_new = np.dot(X_batch_new, w_new) + b_new\n",
        "      error_batch_new = y_hat_batch_new - y_batch_new\n",
        "\n",
        "      # Gradients\n",
        "      dw_new = ((1/len(X_batch_new)))*(np.dot(X_batch_new.T, error_batch_new))\n",
        "      db_new = ((1/len(X_batch_new)))*(np.sum(error_batch_new))\n",
        "\n",
        "      # Update parameters\n",
        "      w_new = w_new - learning_rate_new * dw_new\n",
        "      b_new = b_new - learning_rate_new * db_new\n",
        "\n",
        "  # Calculate loss after each epoch using the full dataset\n",
        "  y_hat_full_new = np.dot(X_new_scaled, w_new) + b_new\n",
        "  current_loss_new = np.mean((y_hat_full_new - y_new)**2)\n",
        "  losses_new.append(current_loss_new)\n",
        "\n",
        "  if abs(prev_loss_new - current_loss_new) < tol_new:\n",
        "        break\n",
        "\n",
        "  prev_loss_new = current_loss_new\n",
        "  epoch_new += 1\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"Mini-Batch GD (2 features) finished after {epoch_new} epochs. Final loss: {current_loss_new:.4f}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Final weights (w_new): {w_new.flatten()}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Final bias (b_new): {b_new.flatten()}\")"
      ],
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Mini-Batch GD (2 features) finished after 99 epochs. Final loss: 0.9543\n",
            "Final weights (w_new): [2.85154769 2.82141818]\n",
            "Final bias (b_new): [13.19889678]\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
